About Chuck

Why I'm Running

I'm Chuck Isbell — a 29-year Rutherford County resident, father, grandfather, tradesperson, and neighbor. I'm running for the Zone 1 School Board seat because I believe our children deserve leaders who show up, do the hard work, and put families first every time.

"I have been part of this community for nearly three decades. I know these schools, these streets, and these families — and I am ready to serve."

My family is at the center of everything I do. I am the father of David, Maggie, and Nate, who passed away in 2020 after being struck by a distracted driver. Losing Nate shaped my commitment to safer roads and safer schools in ways no policy document ever could. That grief became action: I joined Families for Safe Streets and fought alongside parents to restore school bus service that had been taken away to cut costs. We won that fight — and I will keep fighting.

I am also blessed with two wonderful grandchildren, Lilly and Noelle, and I attend Hope Fellowship Church in Smyrna. My family roots in Tennessee run deep, tracing back to the First Families of the State.

Professionally, I work days as a Site Supervisor in Gallatin and evenings as an HVAC Instructor at a Nashville trade school. I know the value of hands-on learning and real-world preparation. I serve as Treasurer for the La Vergne Housing Authority Committee and on the La Vergne Parks & Recreation Advisory Board — because public service isn't something I do in election years. It's who I am.

Our district is making progress. My goal is to build on that progress with steady, accountable leadership — keeping our schools safe, our students supported, and our community informed every step of the way.

Platform

What I Stand For

Six clear commitments to the students, families, teachers, and staff of Rutherford County Zone 1.

01

Safe, Prepared Schools

Every child deserves to feel safe at school. I will ensure our School Resource Officers are central to staff training, emergency preparedness drills, and building relationships with students — strengthening safety at no additional cost to taxpayers.

02

Student Transportation & Access

I fought to end the "Parental Responsibility Zone" policy that stripped bus service from students to save money — and I won. Every student deserves reliable, safe transportation to and from school, full stop.

03

Responsible Budgeting

Smart fiscal decisions mean protecting programs that serve kids — not cutting them to balance a spreadsheet. I will scrutinize every budget line with the same care I bring to managing my own household and professional responsibilities.

04

Supporting Teachers & Staff

Our teachers, bus drivers, and school staff are the backbone of this district. I will advocate for competitive pay, manageable workloads, and an environment where good people want to stay and build careers.

05

Career & Technical Education

As an HVAC instructor, I see every day how vocational training changes lives. I will champion strong CTE programs so every student — whether headed to college or straight into a career — leaves our schools prepared for the real world.

06

Open Community Communication

Parents and neighbors deserve to know what's happening in their schools. I will push for clear, consistent communication from the board — town halls, public updates, and an open door for every family who has a question or concern.

Service Record

Rooted in Community

Chuck's commitment to Rutherford County goes far beyond the campaign trail. Here's where you'll find him serving year-round.

La Vergne Housing Authority

Serving as Treasurer, Chuck helps oversee responsible stewardship of public housing resources and advocates for families across La Vergne.

La Vergne Parks & Rec Advisory Board

Chuck contributes to planning and improving the parks and recreational programs that families and children across La Vergne depend on.

Families for Safe Streets

After losing his son Nate in 2020, Chuck joined this advocacy organization and continues to work toward safer roads for every child in our community.

Hope Fellowship Church, Smyrna

An active member of his faith community, Chuck's values of service, honesty, and care for neighbors shape everything he does in public life.
